card.name: The word effective before contraception
card.fires_on: The word "effective" right after "to use" in counseling lines telling females of reproductive potential to use contraception during treatment. It fires in the patient counseling sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Contraception counseling
modes.description: "effective" follows "reproductive potential to use" just before the word contraception.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use<< effective>> contraception during treatment, and for at least

card.writes: It adds pregnancy-related words (pregnancy, pregnancies, couples) to what comes next, pointing the text toward contraception and pregnancy.
card.plain: It marks the word "effective" in the label line that tells women who could become pregnant to use effective contraception.
